answer_2.quote: we compute the average dynamic time warping (DTW) distances between the pitch contours of GT speech and synthesized speech to measure the pitch accuracy; we calculate the average absolute duration error (DE) in micro-seconds to measure the duration accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We conduct the mean opinion score (MOS) and comparative mean opinion score (CMOS) evaluation to measure the prosody and audio quality.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluated synthesized speech on prosody and overall audio quality using MOS and CMOS scales.
